items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: Lorenzo Tio, but I didn't like him too well.

ctx.x: I wondered if the old time fellas here, like say the Tio's, did you ever hear any of them, Lorenzo Tio? Lorenzo Tio.
Lorenzo Tio, but I didn't like him too well. Uh-uh.
Or Louie Nelson or Piqu and Bach Kay, any of those men? Some of those are left-handed.
